description: Use this when you need to see which MCP event subscriptions are watching inboxes on this account. Read-only. Requires auth. Inputs: none. Returns {object:"list", data:[{object:"event_subscription", id, name, inbox_id, inbox, callback_host, status, refresh_before, created_at, last_delivery_at, last_delivery_status, retained}]}. callback_host is the hostname only. The URL path, query, and signing secret are not returned. Newest created_at first. Ended rows stay in the list with retained true. They are kept for audit, they do not deliver, and they do not count toward the 20 subscription cap. An inbox-scoped key sees only its inbox. A key without webhook_read receives 403 permission_denied.
name: cooper_list_event_subscriptions

outputSchema.description: MCP event subscriptions on the account.

data.description: Items on this page, in the order the tool description gives.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

id.description: Stable id of the returned object. Pass it to the matching get, update, or delete tool.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…) this object belongs to. Null when it applies to every inbox.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.
